description.value: Triple O's is a BC-born quick-service burger chain that grew out of the White Spot family, known for its signature Triple 'O' sauce, hand-scooped milkshakes, and thick-cut Kennebec fries. This Nanaimo location sits on Island Highway North at the Country Club area, making it a roadside stop on a major Vancouver Island cycling corridor. The menu covers breakfast through dinner, with burgers, sides, and a kids menu rounding out the options.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 12m; rack at 72m.
